[SWS_CM_10386] Change of Network Configuration
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00315
⌈
A change of the network configuration shall be possible without re-compiling the in-
volved adaptive applications. – This means that the following changes in the network
configuration shall be possible without the need for a re-compilation of the adaptive
applications:
• changes to one or more attributes of a concrete
ServiceInstance-
ToMachineMapping
(e.g., changing the value of the
SomeipService-
InstanceToMachineMapping
.
udpPort
or the
SomeipServiceInstance-
ToMachineMapping
.
tcpPort
).
⌋
Abstract network protocol bindings for service ports shall be specified inside the service
instance manifest to deploy network bindings of service instances.
